description: Local-only Agentlas context recall plus dependency impact before mutations.
_windowsPathNote: The plugin root is normalized with tr before it is used as a path. On Windows the host hands hook commands to Git Bash with a BACKSLASH root and bash reads \U, \p, \s as escapes (anthropics/claude-code#21878); C:/... is accepted and the conversion is a no-op elsewhere. tr is used because bash ${var//x/y} is a syntax error under dash.

hooks.command: root=$(printf %s "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}" | tr '\\' '/'); if [ -x "${root}/bin/agentlas-memory-hook" ]; then "${root}/bin/agentlas-memory-hook" --host codex --event SessionStart; else printf '{}\n'; fi

root=$(printf %s "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}" | tr '\\' '/'); if [ -x "${root}/bin/agentlas-memory-hook" ]; then "${root}/bin/agentlas-memory-hook" --host codex --event UserPromptSubmit; else printf '{}\n'; fi

root=$(printf %s "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}" | tr '\\' '/'); if [ -x "${root}/bin/agentlas-subagent-hook" ]; then "${root}/bin/agentlas-subagent-hook" --host codex --event SubagentStop; else printf '{}\n'; fi
